| description = Brother of [[Elmion Hendrys]]. Spawns every 2 hours at the Crows pub and walks to the Qeynos Hills zone line where he despawns. He is only active for around 3 minutes before you have to wait for another 2 hours. Has [[a beggar]] placeholder.

Responds to hails even at scowling.

 You say, 'Hail, Faldor Hendrys'
 Faldor Hendrys says, 'What do you want?!! Can't you see I am busy drinking here? You don't even look like you belong here.
 You can have my seat when I am good and ready to leave, which won't be for a while yet. If I were you I would get lost before I got myself hurt.

 You say, 'What Gem of Tunare?
 Faldor Hendrys says, 'Listen buddy!! I do NOT know what you are babbling about! If you know what's good for you, then you'd best leave.'

He may have different dialogue depending on his location. The above is what he said when I talked to him leaving the bar in Qeynos.
